venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 2/18.** Steady but slow: gloomy, much warmer than recent nights which didn't help walk-ups; guests reserved, mostly one or two rounds; plenty of food helped GCA. Okay night, slow and steady. Kitchen: fewer covers but multi-course orders from those who ordered; by 10pm the floor had mostly closed out and the kitchen was called early. Comps $40 (DNL). MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 2/18.** Slow evening with a considerable number of birthdays; room full and lively in the middle turn, closed with smaller groups and couples; waitlist cleared early. Comps $72.80. Top sellers: Wax Simulacra, Material Control, Deviltown. Door: rainy start, slower 6pm, big boost at 8:30pm to a full house, heavy rain again at 9:30, most out by 10pm for work; a few large groups after nearby comedy shows; welcomed Ian from Mr. Melo with Andromeda and Al Sotack with Chris from Cordusio; ~5 birthday celebrations. No no-shows. Repairs: debris falling on top of ice machine (photo in thread).
